fonts: Google Fonts (DM Sans, DM Serif Display)

tokens.name: brand-lime
tokens.usage: The one bright Redox green, shared by every surface: the dashboard's accent fills and marks, the slab's glow, highlights on dark website and slide grounds. A fill or mark, never text on light grounds; on dark grounds it reads as text (5.6:1 on brand-forest). Text on it is ink (8:1). Not over the website's green glows (the footer panel, green callouts): there it drops to 2.6:1.

tokens.name: brand-forest
tokens.usage: The one Redox forest green, shared by every surface: the dashboard's slab, the website footer's deep end, dark slides. brand-lime and white both read on it.

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Page background, under a faint paper grain.

tokens.name: color-panel
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus and dialogs. Light mode sits halfway between the page and white.

tokens.name: color-field-bg
tokens.usage: Form fields' own fill, a step brighter than the card holding them, so data entry stands out from its container.

tokens.name: color-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on rows, menu items and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and card borders. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: color-field
tokens.usage: Form field borders: ink mixed into the rule colour (45% light, 30% dark) so fields reach 3:1 on page and panel.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, panel and field-bg. Also the focus ring (2px, 2px offset).

tokens.name: color-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, placeholders and mono labels on bg, panel and field-bg (4.5:1).

tokens.name: color-brand
tokens.usage: The brand's solid fill: forest ink in light mode, the lime in dark.

tokens.name: color-brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text on color-brand.

tokens.name: color-signal
tokens.usage: The bright accent (brand-lime): primary buttons, section-label blocks, the current tab's underline, set filters, text selection. In light mode always paired with a 1px color-mark-edge outline, since it is close to the page in lightness.

tokens.name: color-signal-ink
tokens.usage: Text on color-signal.

tokens.name: color-alert
tokens.usage: The problem colour in data (low readings, overdue). A mark or bar colour, not body text.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors and required asterisks, as text on bg and panel.

tokens.name: color-danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a color-danger fill (the Delete button in a confirmation).

tokens.name: color-mark-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of indicator marks: section-label block, current-tab underline, set filters.

tokens.name: color-mark-edge
tokens.usage: The thin ink edge around accent marks and primary buttons in light mode; none in dark.

tokens.name: color-deep
tokens.usage: The inverted card.

tokens.name: color-deep-ink
tokens.usage: Text on color-deep.

tokens.name: color-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on color-deep.

tokens.name: color-deep-line
tokens.usage: Rules on color-deep.

tokens.name: color-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs.

tokens.name: color-slab
tokens.usage: The textured slab's body (brand-forest): page and record headers, the current nav row, the active chip.

tokens.name: color-slab-bright
tokens.usage: The slab's lit top-left corner.

tokens.name: color-slab-deep
tokens.usage: The slab's shadowed bottom-right.

tokens.name: color-slab-glow
tokens.usage: The coloured bloom on a slab's right or bottom edge, away from its text.

tokens.name: color-slab-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a slab.

tokens.name: color-slab-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and subtitles on a slab.

tokens.name: color-slab-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on a slab and the borders of its glass cells.

tokens.name: color-slab-glass
tokens.usage: Frosted cells on a slab (record facts, stat cells, glass buttons).

tokens.name: color-slab-accent
tokens.usage: Big numbers and marks on a slab.

tokens.name: color-slab-button
tokens.usage: The main button on a slab, and the current nav row's accent bar.

tokens.name: color-slab-button-ink
tokens.usage: Text on color-slab-button.

tokens.name: color-scene
tokens.usage: Tint for a theme's landscape silhouette along the bottom of the page.

tokens.name: color-logo-word
tokens.usage: The Redox wordmark: warm brown on light, white on dark. Logo only.

tokens.name: color-logo-leaf
tokens.usage: The logo's swoosh and BIO-NUTRIENTS line, in every theme. Logo only, never UI.

tokens.name: web-bg-page
tokens.usage: Website: page background. Dark is a warm near-black so product colour and photos glow.

tokens.name: web-bg-surface
tokens.usage: Website: soft tiles and slabs (bullet tiles, analysis slab, grower quote). Cream in light.

tokens.name: web-bg-raised
tokens.usage: Website: cards sitting on a tinted panel (sidebar document rows).

tokens.name: web-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Website: hairline dividers (FAQ rows). Decorative only.

tokens.name: web-text-primary

tokens.name: web-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Website: supporting copy on web-bg-page and web-bg-surface.

tokens.name: web-text-muted

tokens.name: web-green-dark
tokens.usage: Website: headings' accent, active nav, links. Brightens in dark so it still reads as text.

tokens.name: web-green
tokens.usage: Website: the brand green; default button and bullet colour when a page has no product colour. White text on it is 4.97:1 in light but only 2.85:1 in dark (kept as the source has it).

tokens.name: web-green-light
tokens.usage: Website: gradient partner (leaf sprig primary, card hover).

tokens.name: web-green-pale
tokens.usage: Website: placeholder wash, active nav chip ground, leaf sprig secondary.

tokens.name: web-green-ink
tokens.usage: Website: green text on web-green-pale (the active nav chip).

tokens.name: web-off-white
tokens.usage: Website: chip backgrounds and secondary surface.

tokens.name: web-purple
tokens.usage: Website: secondary accent, only as the minority stop in the button gradient. Never a surface.

tokens.name: web-warning
tokens.usage: Website: caution boxes; fixed, never follows a product's colour.

tokens.name: web-footer-bg
tokens.usage: Website: footer fill, flowing down into web-footer-bg-end.

tokens.name: web-footer-bg-end
tokens.usage: Website: the deep end of the footer gradient, brand-forest in light; near-black in dark.

tokens.name: web-footer-text
tokens.usage: Website: text on the footer.

tokens.name: web-footer-muted
tokens.usage: Website: secondary text on the footer (4.5:1).

tokens.name: web-glass-bg
tokens.usage: Website: frosted panels over photography, with a 24px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: web-chart-2
tokens.usage: Website charts: first supporting bar (the treated bar is the product colour).

tokens.name: web-chart-3
tokens.usage: Website charts: second supporting bar.

tokens.name: web-turf-ink
tokens.usage: Website, Turf product pages only: the fixed dark surface of the turf livery in both themes.
